title: Coordinate-resolvent zero-time commutator anchor
question: Can a position-only boundary bond be paired with a coordinate resolvent so that the relative-cocycle difference has an exact zero first variation, exposing a quadratic-in-time Cook remainder before any unbounded force estimate?

model.boundary_character: B is a polynomial in commuting position coordinates only
model.zero_time_commutator: [B,A_z]=0 for every site s, including sites outside the bond
model.modular_anchor: delta_H Delta(t)=(i/hbar)[H,Delta(t)] has zero first variation at t=0

adversarial_review.check: The boundary term is rebuilt from the manifest Q3 bond polynomial; the zero commutator is tested for every translated coordinate seed and not assumed for momentum seeds.
The first variation is evaluated by a central difference and compared with the exact commutator difference; no small-time fit is relabelled as an identity.
The second-variation reduction is checked against the expanded nested commutator with the declared alpha convention; the reduction is used only after the zero commutator assertion.
A manifest-sized momentum perturbation is added to B in the hostile lane; the commutator and first variation must exceed the mutation threshold.
All matrices are bounded oscillator truncations. No unbounded form-domain, infinite-dimensional Cook remainder or uniform t^2 bound is inferred.
The modular row is a finite commutator diagnostic in the reference H; it is not a BKM, strong-star or representation-independent estimate.
Phase-local BKM control, l1 shell summability, all uniformities, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain false.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks abstract group inversion and noncommutative commutator bookkeeping only; finite matrix spectra, weighted rows and all limits remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: A finite algebraic anchor identifies a coordinate-resolvent subfamily for which the relative-cocycle first variation vanishes and the second variation reduces to one nested boundary commutator.
qft_interface.open: The actual phase-local BKM estimate, shell summability, cutoff/source/volume/shape uniformity, invariant domain, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary finite coordinate-resolvent interface only; no production owner, physical-empty reference or Clay conclusion is supplied.

boundary: Claim-nonbearing finite checkpoint only. It establishes a zero-time commutator anchor for coordinate resolvents against position-only bond additions on two bounded Q3 truncations. It proves no uniform quadratic remainder, no Cook limit and no QFT closure.
no_overclaim: The exact finite anchor is a route simplification, not a thermodynamic estimate: after time zero, the evolved boundary and observable need not commute, and unbounded domain and shell summability obligations remain.
